name: Kyouiku Mama to Oba to Oba
original_name: 教育ママと伯母と叔母
source: Kazuya Ubukata is a ronin student going to a prep school to get into college. He is living with his mom and 2 aunts who have different personalities and life styles. Secretly is in love with his mother but has trouble dealing with her high expectations and strict rules. After being caught masturbating one day his relationship with mom and aunts changes.
translation: 生方和也是一名在补习学校备考大学的复读生。他和母亲以及两位性格、生活方式各异的姑妈住在一起。他暗恋着自己的母亲，但难以承受她的高期望和严格规矩。有一天自慰被撞见后，他与母亲和姑妈们的关系发生了改变。
